messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.4.2.3

1.4.2.3. Adjustable guards restricting access Adjustable guards restricting access to those areas of the moving parts strictly necessary for the work shall be: (a) adjustable manually or automatically, depending on the type of work involved; and (b) readily adjustable without the use of tools.

response.text:
Adjustable guards restricting access | mustBeAdjustableManuallyOrAutomatically | adjustable manually or automatically | depending on the type of work involved | "shall be: (a) adjustable manually or automatically, depending on the type of work involved"
Adjustable guards restricting access | mustBeReadilyAdjustableWithoutTools | readily adjustable without the use of tools | "" | "(b) readily adjustable without the use of tools"
Adjustable guards restricting access | restrictAccessTo | those areas of the moving parts strictly necessary for the work | "" | "Adjustable guards restricting access to those areas of the moving parts strictly necessary for the work"
